mapping.draft_py:
# Faerie Miscreant (M20). "When this creature enters, if you control another creature named Faerie
# Miscreant, draw a card." Turret Ogre's intervening-if ("if you control another creature with
# ...", B2a-turret-ogre) with the power test replaced by NAME_EQ (Frantic Inventory's "named"),
# and Llanowar Visionary's ETB draw (B2a-etb-draw-one) as the effect.
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
        count=QConst(value=1),
        inner_filter=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.NAME_EQ, string_value='Faerie Miscreant'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, if you control another creature named Faerie Miscreant, draw a card.

mapping.notes: G1's board has no second Miscreant, so the draw is never exercised there.
